outcome.pre_change_code_path_review: Source inspection showed that the projection selected the first record's definition when summarizing a shared pressure identity and did not surface disagreements between definitions.
outcome.analysis_limit: This is one observed projection ambiguity in evidence about one Compiler session. It does not establish recurrence across Compiler sessions or identify a cause for the underlying Control continuation pressure.

pressure_hypothesis.title: A shared pressure identity can carry conflicting recorded recommendations
pressure_hypothesis.basis: Two authentic observations about the same Compiler campaign pressure share one pressure identity but prescribe different Control continuation behavior. The prior projection summarized the first definition without exposing the conflict, making the actionable recommendation depend on record order.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: When a pressure identity has conflicting recorded metadata, expose the conflicting fields and supporting observation identities, and omit ambiguous summary values instead of selecting one by ledger order.
